Procs

proc enableKtls(fd: SocketHandle) {....raises: [KtlsKeyUpdateNeeded, KtlsError],
                                    tags: [], forbids: [].}

Attach the "tls" ULP to an established TCP socket. Must precede setTx/setRx.

Raises KtlsError: ENOPROTOOPT/ENOENT means the kernel lacks kTLS; ENOTCONN means the socket is not an established TCP socket.

proc setRx(fd: SocketHandle; km: KeyMaterial) {.
    ...raises: [KtlsKeyUpdateNeeded, KtlsError], tags: [], forbids: [].}
Install receive keys: subsequent recvs return kernel-decrypted plaintext. Raises KtlsError (see setTx for rekeying). 
proc setRxExpectNoPad(fd: SocketHandle; enable: bool) {.
    ...raises: [KtlsKeyUpdateNeeded, KtlsError], tags: [], forbids: [].}
Request opportunistic zero-copy on receive. Requires TLS 1.3 with RX already installed — call after setRx. Raises KtlsError. 
proc setTx(fd: SocketHandle; km: KeyMaterial) {.
    ...raises: [KtlsKeyUpdateNeeded, KtlsError], tags: [], forbids: [].}
Install transmit keys: subsequent sends are encrypted by the kernel. Raises KtlsError (EBUSY if TX is already installed and the version is not TLS 1.3 — use updateTxKey for 1.3 rekeying). 
proc setTxMaxPayloadLen(fd: SocketHandle; maxLen: uint16) {.
    ...raises: [KtlsKeyUpdateNeeded, KtlsError], tags: [], forbids: [].}
Cap plaintext bytes per record (kernel-validated, at most 16384). Raises KtlsError (EBUSY while a record is open). 
proc setTxZerocopy(fd: SocketHandle; enable: bool) {.
    ...raises: [KtlsKeyUpdateNeeded, KtlsError], tags: [], forbids: [].}
Toggle TX zerocopy (sendfile) mode. Raises KtlsError on failure. 
proc txConf(fd: SocketHandle): tuple[version: TlsVersion, cipher: CipherSuite] {.
    ...raises: [KtlsKeyUpdateNeeded, KtlsError], tags: [], forbids: [].}
Read back the installed TX state (4-byte header getsockopt). Raises KtlsError when no TX state is installed. 
proc updateRxKey(fd: SocketHandle; km: KeyMaterial) {.
    ...raises: [KtlsKeyUpdateNeeded, KtlsError], tags: [], forbids: [].}
TLS 1.3 KeyUpdate on the receive path: unblocks reads paused with EKEYEXPIRED (KtlsKeyUpdateNeeded). Same constraints as setRx. 
proc updateTxKey(fd: SocketHandle; km: KeyMaterial) {.
    ...raises: [KtlsKeyUpdateNeeded, KtlsError], tags: [], forbids: [].}
TLS 1.3 KeyUpdate on the transmit path. Same syscall as setTx; the kernel rejects version/cipher changes with EINVAL.
